export_note: Arrays longer than 64 items are omitted; retained values are unchanged. No metrics are recomputed.

data.prompt_protocol: one independent positive point or one tight GT box per row; no mask inputs; no extra clicks or fusion
data.timing_contract: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: one-pass synchronized eager segment times, no warmup/repeated performance inference; full per-image wall includes comparisons, CPU copies, exports/NPZ I/O and quality metrics unless deferred
data.quality_limits: small fixed development diagnosis, not SOTA; GT oracles use extra ground truth and are not deployable
